show.description_secondary: Siddharth, an honest police inspector, gets transferred to a new police station. In that station’s limits, a girl goes missing, and he starts investigating the case. The case becomes very complicated, and at one stage, Siddharth finds out that everything is connected to a serial killer. When he discovers this, his higher officials try to stop him from doing his job. Did the honest inspector finally find the truth behind the serial murders…?”
